caption: Home screen after the dev-ki merge: the green 'Learn Lunima' tour entry point coexists with the curated example ladder and its one-line descriptions from #1096.
Starting the tour shows the non-modal card at step 1/3, asking the user to place a component from the library.
The engine observes the real canvas: adding a component auto-advances the card to step 2/3, connecting two pins.
Routing a waveguide between two pins advances to the final step 3/3, running the light simulation.
